# Daniel Hunt

> I help businesses replace spreadsheets and manual work with custom software, automation, and AI — while building everything in public.

- **Name:** Daniel Hunt
- **Role:** Software engineer and consultant
- **Website:** https://danielhunt.dev
- **Email:** contact@danielhunt.dev
- **Based:** Simi Valley, California
- **LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/in/danielhunt16/
- **X:** https://x.com/danielhunt_dev

## Services

- **Workflow automation:** eliminate repetitive work through automation and AI — manual workflows, AI-powered document processing, approval workflows, internal AI assistants, spreadsheet automation.
- **Custom internal software:** software tailored to a company's operations instead of generic SaaS — internal dashboards, admin portals, operations software, scheduling, inventory, customer portals.
- **Data & reporting:** disconnected business data turned into actionable insight — executive dashboards, KPI reporting, business intelligence, ETL pipelines, reporting automation.

## Philosophy

Build in public. Live offline. Great systems create freedom: the process of designing software, automating workflows, and building products is shared publicly so others can learn from it, and the goal of every system is less time managing work and more time living life.

## Contact

A process worth automating, a spreadsheet that should be software, data you can't see into — or a conversation worth having:
contact@danielhunt.dev
